name: openpixo/dark-gothic
title: Dark gothic
description: Weathered stone, candlelit metal and disciplined silhouettes for somber fantasy.

description_i18n.en: Weathered stone, candlelit metal and disciplined silhouettes for somber fantasy.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用风化石材、烛光金属与克制轮廓，塑造肃静的暗色奇幻世界。

examples.title: Bell tower entrance
examples.prompt: Generate an abandoned bell tower entrance using the dark-gothic art style, with worn stone stairs, a narrow iron gate and one candlelit alcove. Keep the entrance shape readable from game-camera distance.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 dark-gothic 美术风格生成废弃钟楼入口：磨损石阶、狭窄铁门和一处烛光壁龛。确保从游戏镜头距离也能看清入口形状。

examples.title: Relic inventory icons
examples.prompt: Create four matching relic icons using the dark-gothic art style: tarnished censer, cracked bell, wax-sealed key and bone-handled lantern. Use cool shadows and small candlelight accents.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 dark-gothic 美术风格制作四枚配套遗物图标：失光香炉、裂纹铃铛、蜡封钥匙和骨柄灯笼。统一冷色阴影与少量烛光点色。

style.prompt: Dark gothic fantasy game artwork with weathered stone, oxidized metal, heavy cloth and restrained pointed architectural motifs. Deep blue-gray shadow masses, pale bone highlights and small warm candlelight accents from the shared palette. Sculpt forms through controlled chiaroscuro, preserve a readable outer silhouette and reserve fine detail for a single focal area.
style.negativePrompt: bright candy palette, neon glow, excessive ornament, muddy unreadable shadows, photographic gore, modern machinery, glossy plastic, overexposed bloom, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Value-defined silhouette with restrained sharp edge accents.
